What is the Revolut POS, and how does it work?
items.description:
The Revolut Point of Sale (POS) is an app designed to help merchants efficiently manage their in-person sales and operations.

It allows your business to identify and select items for sale, easily process customer orders, create bills, facilitate payments, and accurately log all transactions — streamlining your entire sales workflow from selection to payment.

items.title: What are the key features and benefits of the Revolut POS?
items.description:
Operational efficiency

  • Seamless hardware integration — works with the Revolut Terminal and Tap to Pay on iPhone
  • Kitchen communication — sends orders directly for faster prep
  • Integrated payments and money management — simplifies financial reconciliation by allowing you to accept payments directly into your Business account
  • Order and Pay — facilitates faster table service and customer orders
  • Flexible billing — enables easy bill splitting for quicker checkouts

Growth and insights

  • Powerful analytics — make data-driven decisions with insights into sales, staff, and trends
  • Customer loyalty — boost repeat business by offering your customers discounts and RevPoints

Cost savings and fast payments

  • Free POS software — no monthly subscription fees
  • Competitive pricing — low transaction fees with 24-hour settlement

items.title: What reports and analytics are available with the Revolut POS?
items.description:
The Revolut POS provides built-in analytics to help you monitor and optimise your business. You can access detailed reports covering:

  • store performance — track transactions, sales trends, and refunds, with breakdowns by fulfilment type and payment method
  • product performance — identify top-selling products and categories, and monitor the number of products sold over time
  • staff reports — view individual sales data, tips earned, and timesheets

This data allows you to spot key insights at a glance and make strategic decisions with in-depth period comparisons (e.g. month-over-month or week-over-week).

items.title: Can I use the POS on multiple devices in different locations?
items.description: Yes. The Revolut POS app is multi-device compatible and lets you manage multiple locations and staff at the same time, with no subscription fee. You can customise the settings on each device to suit specific needs.

items.title: What hardware is compatible with the Revolut POS?
items.description:
The Revolut POS is a digital solution — to set it up, you’ll need the following hardware:

Devices

The app is compatible with:

  • iPhones running iOS 15.0 and later
  • iPads running iPadOS 15.0 or newer
  • Macs running macOS 12.0 or later with an Apple M1 chip or newer

Payment processing hardware

You can process payments using:

  • Tap to Pay on iPhone — start accepting contactless payments in seconds, directly on your iPhone
  • The Revolut Terminal — our most advanced payment device, capable of printing receipts and more

Product availability varies per market. Fees apply.

Receipt printers

The POS integrates with leading receipt printers. We recommend:

  • Star printers (specifically the Star TSP 100 III)
  • Epson printers (specifically the Epson TM-m30III)
  • Our Revolut Terminal

You can also use compatible cash drawers to store cash.

items.title: How do I start using the Revolut POS?
items.description:
Get started with Revolut POS by signing up online or downloading the iOS app. Then complete your setup by:

  • Adding your products manually, or importing them using our bulk import feature
  • Setting up your grid layout
  • Adding your floor plan, if applicable
  • Applying and setting up an active Revolut Business Merchant account to accept payments
  • Ordering a Terminal, or setting up Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept payments

Product availability varies by market.

items.title: What languages does the Revolut POS support?
items.description: Your POS will use the same language as your device. We support 10+ languages.

items.title: How much does the Revolut POS software cost?
items.description: The Revolut POS app comes at no additional cost with your Revolut Business account.

items.title: Can I use my existing payment processor?
items.description: The Revolut POS app is compatible only with Revolut payment hardware devices, including the Revolut Terminal and Tap to Pay on iPhone.
